theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the #1 rank, is trend-gate eligible, has the highest durability bar among eligible leaders (0.62), and has the broadest participation (0.643), indicating the leadership is not a single-name spike. The crowded flag (z=1.01) is a size-down caution, not a fade, so the lean is continuation rather than chase. Weak directional track record and mixed Hurst tag keep conviction low.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.01 with one_narrative=false and mixed Hurst suggests the move may already be mature; energy leadership can reverse sharply on a macro/geopolitical headline, and the detector's rank has ~0 forward IC.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO fails to hold above its 20-day relative trend vs the S&P/TSX benchmark before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals is the #2 rank and is trend-gate eligible with broad rotation participation (56% of themes eligible), and is the only challenger within a narrow margin (0.223) of the leader. Durability (0.52) is weaker than Oil & Gas and the Hurst tag is mean-revert, which argues against a strong trend call, but the eligible non-crowded status makes it the most credible secondary leadership candidate. Low conviction reflects the detector's weak rank-IC.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst and a durability well below the leader suggest this is an early, unproven challenger; no validated timing edge exists to confirm a leadership handoff, and directional accuracy is poor.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lagging XEG.TO by more than 4% on a relative basis before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only eligible theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and a durability bar of 0.60, which on the validated trend-gate leg means staying power and lower drawdown risk relative to higher-beta leaders. Rank #5 is mid-pack, so this is a trend-duration lean, not a momentum-timing call. Uncrowded (z=0.26) with solid eligibility supports a modest continuation read.
theses.dissent: Financials leadership is slow and grind-prone; a market-level risk-off or rate surprise could hit banks despite trend health, and the detector's rank adds no timing information.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its 200-day trend without recovery within the check-by horizon.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
